proposals.evidence: DEDR 156 full article (p. 15) gives 156 (a) Ta. appaṉ, appu father; term of endearment used to little children or inferiors; appacci father; appāttai elder sister; appi mistress of house; elder sister. Ma. appan father; appu a Bhat appe “mother” matches Lindgren Koraga appe “mother” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
